svg.title: Generational Garbage Collection Lifecycle
svg.desc: Animated diagram showing new object allocation in Eden via TLAB, Minor GC sweeping unreachable objects and copying live survivors between S0 and S1 while incrementing age, and promotion to Old Tenured Gen once age reaches MaxTenuringThreshold.
svg.text: Eden Allocation (TLAB) • Minor GC & Survivor S0 ⇄ S1 Ping-Pong • Tenured Promotion
